Hi Rachael — thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- Primary goals: prototype Redwood inference for Acme’s customer support summarization pipeline, 24-48ms median token latency target, and per-org data isolation for PII.
- Proposed pilot: 4-week sandbox with up to 3 devs, shared test dataset, and weekly check-ins.
- Success metrics: 1) latency under 50ms median on {demo traffic}, 2) label-level quality >= 0.88 on your eval set, 3) documented deployment runbook for handoff.

Next steps / asks:
1) I’ll send our MSA + SOW for legal review (expected early this week).
2) Can you share the procurement contact(s) and any standard PO/contract clauses we should expect?
3) Let us know target start week for pilot — we had Slack/next-week and mid-March as options.

If it helps, Marissa can join procurement/legal syncs. Proposed times for a short 30m follow-up: Thu 3/5 10am PT or Mon 3/9 9am PT.

Thanks — I’ll send the contract over today.

—

Dylan — thanks for the recap and the patience. Attaching our redlines to the MSA (Acme_Redlines_MSA.pdf). I routed to our legal counsel and procurement; procurement@acme.com is on the thread.

High level items we flagged:
- Data handling and deletion windows for sandbox data
- IP carveouts for customer-produced evaluation sets
- Indemnity and liability caps tied to production usage

If you can confirm how Redwood handles sandbox data retention and whether you can accept the proposed liability language (or propose a counter), that would be helpful. Also please include an estimate of how contract changes might impact start timeline — procurement is hoping we can start pilot in late March but counsel may need >2 weeks.

Thanks — happy to set a short call with counsel if helpful.

Regards,
Rachael Green
Senior Product Manager — AI Initiatives
Acme Corp

Hi Rachael / procurement team — thanks for sending the redlines and routing them to counsel. I’m Marissa on Redwood’s commercial team and I’ll coordinate the legal side with Jonas. A few quick notes and options to keep momentum:

1) Sandbox data retention: Redwood can commit to a 30-day sandbox-data retention window by default; we can shorten this to 7 days for pilot-only data on request and provide a deletion certificate at the end of the pilot. We will add the deletion SOP to the SOW.

2) IP for evaluation sets: we typically agree to carveouts for customer-provided evaluation data (no model ownership transfer) and will add explicit language in the SOW about usage restrictions and non-commercial evaluation.

3) Liability / indemnity: Jonas (cc’d) and our legal team propose a pilot-scoped liability cap (e.g., fees paid for the pilot) with production caps to be negotiated in the enterprise MSA. I’ve attached a short counterproposal that narrows the liability exposure for pilot activities while addressing Acme’s concern.

4) Timeline: if counsel needs >2 weeks we can still kick off a limited pilot-only addendum that allows non-production testing while final MSA is negotiated. If you can share a target procurement window we’ll prioritize support.

If helpful, Jonas and I can join a 30m call with your counsel to walk through the redlines and try to close quickly. Proposed times: Tue 3/16 9am PT or Wed 3/17 11am PT.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0144

Attachment: Redwood_Counterproposal_MSA_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 98KB)
